title: Synthetic route p95 instrumentation + KV-cache correlation and circuit-trace linkage for multi-region failover
creator: Maya Hernandez
description: Create a set of synthetic route-level SLIs that measure p95 token latency per route and correlate those measurements with KV-cache hit rates and circuit-breaker provenance. Produce a Grafana dashboard and alerts that help on-call and SREs quickly determine whether tail latency is caused by cache misses, admission control, or regional failover. This ticket covers the metric instrumentation, synthetic traffic harness, trace linking (request -> circuit decision -> region), dashboard panels, and an initial alerting plan.
comments: 2025-02-14 Maya Hernandez: Initial triage. Problem: sporadic p95 spikes for /generate routes affecting latency SLIs. Existing dashboards show p50/p99 but lack per-route p95 and linkage to KV cache hit rates and CB decisions. Proposal: synthetic per-route probes + traceable metadata for circuit decisions.

2025-02-17 Oliver Grant: Proposed measurement plan added to Confluence. Will instrument route tag on synthetic traffic and surface tokenized p95 using the new histogram aggregation pipeline. Need an event emitted when admission/circuit decision occurs with decision_reason and target_region fields. Blocking question: can runtime emit decision_reason without high cardinality?

2025-02-20 Infrastructure review (Priya Singh): Agreed to emit decision_reason as low-cardinality enum and decision_id for trace linking. KV-cache hit metadata will be emitted as boolean and cache_tier string. Asked to add sampling for non-synthetic traffic to verify correlation before rolling to synthetic-only alerts.

2025-02-25 Design review (Evan Cho): Dashboard wireframe looked good. Requested a 'cost-of-fallback' panel showing token delta when fallback to cheaper model occurs during failover. Added as nice-to-have not in initial scope.

2025-03-01 Oliver Grant: Implemented synthetic harness PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4881 — generates route-tagged traffic and emits traceable decision_id header. Added metric names: synthetic.route.p95_ms, synthetic.route.token_count, synthetic.route.kv_cache_hit_rate. PTAL.

2025-03-03 Maya Hernandez: Dashboard draft deployed to staging Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rlbXq2/reliability-route-p95 — includes p95 heatmap, KV-hit correlation scatter, and circuit-trace waterfall. Need to add alert thresholds and playbook steps.

2025-03-04 SRE sync (Liam O'Connor): Agreed alerting thresholds: p95 > 450ms and synthetic.route.kv_cache_hit_rate < 0.6 for 5m -> fire INVESTIGATION alert; p95 > 800ms with decision_reason == REGION_FALLBACK -> P0 incident page. Next: create runbook entries and QA with canary region.

Next steps: finish low-cardinality decision_reason emission for real traffic, add sampled trace linking to Honeycomb, finalize alerting rules and runbook, and schedule 48h staging soak before promoting dashboard to prod.
